title: Short-Range Spin Glasses
exact_target: Determine whether short-range spin glasses have a phase transition, how many pure-state pairs occur, and how those pairs appear in large volumes.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 7800011 (AMR-077-0011). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
C. M. Newman and D. L. Stein, original contribution to Open Problems in Mathematical Physics (1998), edited by Michael Aizenman.

status_qualification: The final small-field question and the almost-sure quantifier are restored from the original source; they were omitted from the short catalogue summary.
